marta: FYI I noticed an alert this morning for a big spike in prefix misses on kv-prod (KV_PREFIX_MISS_RATE > 15% for 5m). Where do folks usually look for quick context (dashboards/logs/traces)?
ryan: Start with the grafana prefix dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefix/kv-prefix-hitrate?orgId=1&var-env=prod :eyes:
ryan: Traces are in jaeger, filter service=kv and operation=GetPrefix — that usually shows if a particular client is hammering new prefixes: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=kv&operation=GetPrefix
ryan: Quick PromQL to check miss ratio: `sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_misses[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_lookups[5m]))` set namespace=prod.
anita: There was a small deploy at 03:40 UTC that adjusted prefix TTLs, might be related. I flagged infra on the deploy notes.
marta: thanks, can you paste the deploy id?
anita: `deploy/kv-2026-03-17-03-40` in the release bot. linked here: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/kv/15234
ryan: Ran a quick log query in our ELK: `index=prod-kv AND message:*prefix* | json | stats count() by prefix | sort -count` — top noisy prefixes right now: `session:`, `user:avatar:` and `temp-token:`. High cardinality for session keys.
ryan: I also checked traces — a handful of clients (mobile-sync and search-service) started requesting more unique prefixes after the deploy.
kv-monitor-bot: Alert KV_PREFIX_MISS_RATE acknowledged by ryan at 1778345650
marta: OK, action items: 1) Ryan to triage and see if we can add an exclusion for session: prefixes in the alert, 2) Anita to confirm deploy rollback window if needed, 3) I'll open a quick follow-up ticket to tune alerting and track TTL rollback options.
ryan: SG, i'll create the ticket and propose short-term fix: increase alert window to 10m + exclude session: and temp-token: prefixes, then follow with infra fix to reduce cardinality.
marta: Can you drop the dashboard panel link in the ticket? Pin it here once ready.
ryan: Will do. Dashboard overview I'll pin to the ticket: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefix/kv-prefix-overview
anita: I'll stand by on rollback, but prefer alert tuning first so we don't noise the oncall if this is expected post-deploy behavior.
marta: sounds good. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ryan: marking as in-progress, will update ticket and post back in this thread when done.
